findings.title: Lone carriage returns hide failure line and URL
findings.problem:
analyzeProxyOutput strips ANSI (which only normalises 
 to 
) and then splits on '
' only. A spinner frame joined to the next line by a lone '' (for example '⠋ Installing...✗ reason') leaves the line starting with spinner text, so the anchored /^\s*(✗|error:|failed:)/ and /^\s*Download page:/ patterns miss it.
findings.impact: On an install failure the row may show only the generic 'Install failed (exit N).' and no 'Open the download page' button, defeating the failure acceptance criterion. Reachability against real CLI output was unconfirmed, so severity is capped at major.
findings.recommendation:
Split on /
||
/ in analyzeProxyOutput (or normalise lone  to 
 in stripAnsi) and add a test with a spinner-prefixed ✗ line and Download page line.
